title: The problems with (most) team-building efforts and how to avoid them

featuredImage.alt: Alan Cho, Senior UX Designer, and Grace Ge, UX Research, learning from each other.

seo.titleRendered: The problems with (most) team-building efforts and how to avoid them | O3

flexible_post_content.text_editor:
Team building exercises can play an important role in creating a close company culture and improving employee relations, but they’re only helpful if they’re done right.

Our People Growth Manager Beth Perkins knows what it takes to build a successful and cooperative team. She recently gave some insight into what can make team-building exercises truly valuable for the Society for Human Resource Management (SHRM).
